en-US: Build 225 contains the same fixes as the Build 224 candidate (Runtime v2 startup/migration repairs, local-model residency, PPT edit entry, GitHub-first sharded Gitee fallback) and repairs the one Swift 6 typed-throws compile error that stopped the Build 224 accepted-SDK App build in the Linux image downloader. Mirror switching stays fail-closed (only network loss or 5xx/408/429 activates Gitee; definite 4xx, invalid responses, local rejections and cancellation never switch sources), and a URLSession cancellation is classified as cancellation only while the task is actually cancelled. Please retest opening an existing Linux install, environment migration/repair, package persistence, local-model multi-turn tools with long gaps, PPT edit/save/reopen, and downloads on a slow or interrupted network. This is source-candidate evidence only: cloud build, upload, Apple processing, TestFlight availability and physical-device verification are not yet complete; the immutable failed Build 224 tag v1.7.0-beta.81 / run 35767875337 is retained as the failure record.
zh-Hans: Build 225 与 Build 224 候选的修复内容一致（Runtime v2 启动/迁移修复、本地模型驻留、PPT 编辑入口、GitHub 优先的分片 Gitee 回退），并修复了阻断 Build 224 验收 SDK App 构建的唯一一处 Swift 6 类型化抛错编译错误（Linux 镜像下载器）。镜像切换保持 fail closed：只有断网或 5xx/408/429 才启用 Gitee，明确 4xx、无效响应、本地拒绝与取消绝不切源；URLSession 的取消只在任务确已取消时才归类为取消。请重点复测打开已有 Linux、环境迁移/修复、软件包持久化、长间隔下本地模型多轮工具、PPT 编辑保存重开，以及慢速或中断网络下的下载。本构建仅有源码候选证据：云端构建、上传、Apple 处理、TestFlight 可用性与真机验证均尚未完成；失败的不可变 Build 224 标签 v1.7.0-beta.81 / run 35767875337 作为失败记录保留。
